Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionGrab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path. But you can't just paint everything you see: each color has an exact number of tiles that must be filled! Move across the environment in four directions and carefully plan your routes. Every tile you pass over is painted with your current color, but retracing a path already painted with the same color makes the paint disappear, allowing you to correct part of your route and discover new solutions. Along the way, you'll find sprays in different colors. Collecting them permanently changes your paint color, completely transforming the possibilities of the level. Choose when and where to change colors, and think a few steps ahead to avoid leaving paint where it shouldn't be! As you progress, new challenges enter the scene. Blocking Tiles can become inaccessible after being crossed, while Clean Tiles must remain completely unpainted until the end. Every movement can change your options, so planning the right route is essential. There is no game over for mistakes, so feel free to experiment! Use Undo or Restart whenever you need and discover the best way to meet every painting objective exactly. Choose your colors, trace the perfect path, and turn every environment into a true work of art!Show morePublished byAfil GamesDeveloped byAfil GamesPlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionShe meant well "Your big flower delivery came, so I unpacked it all for you!" Your niece has a spare key and the best of intentions. The shop opens tomorrow, and every flower you ordered is somewhere on the floor. It's okay. You know where they all go. An armful at a time Pick flowers up until your arms are full. Cycle through what you are carrying, find the basket that wants a rose, and set it in. Each basket takes one kind of flower, and it tells you when it is done. Make it yours Every basket can be painted. Pick a colour, or several, and lay them in bands, alternate them round the rim, or scatter them. The finished shop is one you arranged, not one you were handed. No timers No score, no upgrades to grind, no one waiting. Stop when you like and come back to the same floor. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREIn this bundleWarrior Cats: Clans of the ForestView gameWarrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - The Purrfect Look PackView add-onDescriptionPre-order and get the exclusive Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - The Purrfect Look Pack which features additional unique elements for the cat creator. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself. AN ORIGINAL STORY Embark on a brand-new journey with iconic cats and locations from the Warrior Cats franchise. CREATE YOUR OWN WARRIOR CAT Using the robust cat creator, name and create your very own Warrior Cat. GAME FEATURES: * 3 Game types: Prophecy Mode, Defender Mode, Skirmish Mode. Prophecy Mode - Four original stories about the trials and tribulations of Clan life. Defender mode - Test how long you can last while battling all of the game’s fiercest enemies in a single run. Skirmish mode - Battle other players online asynchronously. * Create your own unique Warrior Cat with millions of possible customization combinations. * 6 iconic locations from the book series: ThunderClan territory, RiverClan territory, ShadowClan territory, WindClan territory, The Moonpool and The Island. * Turn-based combat system with up to 3 versus 3 battles. * 75 unique combat moves to discover and unlock. * Interact with 9 cats from the beloved book series. * Battle a large variety of enemies including badgers, vicious foxes, imposing Dobermanns, rival Clan cats and many more. * Track and hunt birds, rabbits, squirrels and other prey. * Visit your friend's camp online asynchronously. * You can also help friends with by crafting items or gifting them necessary resources and materials. * No two playthroughs are the same as characters, quests and stories are procedurally generated.Show morePublished byTrailmark GamesDeveloped byBamtang GamesRelease date10/23/2026Play withPCXBOX Series X|SCapabilities4K Ultra HDHDR10Single player60 fps+Optimized for Xbox Series X|SPC Game PadCompare editionsTHIS EDITIONWarrior Cats: Clans of the Forest$29.99+Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest$29.99+THIS EDITIONGames includedWarrior Cats: Clans of the ForestAdd-ons includedWarrior Cats: Clans of the Forest -
